dishes.make_ahead: Steam and cool the cakes up to 2 days ahead, covered in the fridge; slice and fry just before serving

steps.text: Grate the daikon and simmer in its juice for 10 minutes.
Fry the diced Chinese sausages, the soaked chopped shiitake and the spring onions for 3 minutes.
Mix into the daikon with the rice flour, the water, the salt and the sugar.
Press into an oiled 20cm square tin and steam 45 minutes.
Cool completely, then slice into squares and fry in oil 3 minutes a side until crisp.
Serve with oyster sauce and chilli oil.

veg.make_ahead: Steam, cool and chill the cakes up to 3 days ahead, covered; slice and pan fry until crisp on the night

ingredients.item: vegetarian mushroom oyster sauce, to taste

steps.text: Soak the dried shiitake mushrooms in hot water. Grate the daikon and simmer in its own juice for 10 minutes.
Fry the finely diced smoked tofu, the chopped soaked shiitake and the sliced spring onions in a little oil for 3 minutes.
Mix into the daikon with the rice flour, the water, the salt and the sugar.
Press into an oiled 20cm square tin and steam 45 minutes.
Cool completely, then slice into squares and fry in oil 3 minutes a side until crisp.
Serve with the vegetarian mushroom oyster sauce and chilli oil.

dishes.make_ahead: Make the dough and prove it in the fridge up to 1 day ahead; fill, prove and steam on the day

steps.text: Mix the flour, the dried yeast, the sugar and the warm milk into a smooth dough and prove 1 hour.
Divide into equal portions, fill each with a spoon of red bean paste and pinch closed.
Prove 20 minutes, then steam 12 minutes until puffed.

dishes.make_ahead: Make the broth and boil the eggs up to 2 days ahead and keep chilled; reheat the broth and cook the noodles and bok choy on the night

steps.text: Simmer the chicken stock with the sliced shiitake for 10 minutes.
Boil the eggs for 6 minutes, cool and peel.
Cook the egg noodles and divide into bowls, add the halved bok choy blanched in the broth, ladle over the stock and top with halved eggs and sliced spring onion.

veg.make_ahead: Simmer the broth with the dried shiitake, ginger and soy up to 3 days ahead and keep chilled; add the fresh shiitake and cook the noodles on the night

steps.text: Simmer the stock with the dried shiitake, ginger and soy for 15 minutes, then add the sliced fresh shiitake for 5 minutes.
Boil the eggs for 6 minutes, cool and peel.
Cook the egg noodles and divide into bowls, add the halved bok choy blanched in the broth, ladle over the broth and top with halved eggs and sliced spring onion.

dishes.make_ahead: Shape the buns up to 1 day ahead, covered in the fridge; steam and dab with the colouring on the day

steps.text: Make a dough of the flour, the yeast, the sugar and the warm water and prove 1 hour.
Shape the balls around red bean paste, pinch a point and score a crease like a peach.
Steam 12 minutes, then dab the tips with a little red colouring.

dishes.make_ahead: Soak, simmer, steep and chill the cooler up to 3 days ahead, covered in the fridge; serve over ice on the night

steps.text: Rinse the dried smoked plums (wumei) and the dried hawthorn slices and soak in the water for 30 minutes.
Bring to the boil and simmer 40 minutes.
Add the rock sugar and stir until dissolved, then take off the heat and stir in the dried osmanthus.
Steep 10 minutes, strain and chill well.
Serve over ice with a little extra osmanthus on top.
